items.quote: Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.
items.contrast: Jeroboam is the person performing the consecration; anyone wanting to become a priest is the recipient.
items.reason: The pronoun “he” refers to Jeroboam, the named actor in the preceding sentence. Answering requires distinguishing the actor from the people he consecrated.
